parsed.rationale: Both `NowPlayingItem` (AppServices package, `Shared/AppServices/Sources/AppServices/NowPlayingService.swift:23`) and `PlaycutSelection` (app:iOS package, `WXYC/iOS/Views/Playlist/PlaylistView.swift:23`) are `type-alias-object` records sharing two fields — `playcut:Playcut` and an artwork field — differing only in the concrete image type (`Image?` vs `UIImage?`). This is a textbook PAT opportunity: a `PlaycutRepresentable` protocol with `associatedtype ArtworkImage` captures the shared shape while allowing each package to bind `ArtworkImage` to its platform-appropriate type (`SwiftUI.Image` in AppServices/shared context, `UIKit.UIImage` in the iOS app layer). This eliminates the structural duplication without forcing a cross-layer image-type dependency.
